T: It's Friday. You ain't got no job. You got snacks.
D: Two friends sit on a front porch in South Central LA through one very long Friday.
P: Serve the snacks when Craig and Smokey settle in on the porch.
S: Smokey: never two things that match, so this time they do

Thick white bread filled with peanut butter and strawberry jam, fried golden in butter, dusted with icing sugar and cut into triangles for the porch. Spread 8 slices of thick white bread with 160g smooth peanut butter on four slices and 160g strawberry jam on the other four. Press together into 4 sandwiches and butter the outsides with 40g soft butter. Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the filling is warm. Dust with icing sugar, cut into triangles and serve warm.
Little beef sliders topped with a slice of grilled ham and melted cheese on soft buns, so the ham finally gets its burger.
something cold and sharp for a hot day on the porch

Fresh pineapple cut into long spears, charred on a hot grill pan, then dusted with chilli, lime zest, sugar and salt and served cold on a stick. Peel and core a large pineapple and cut into 12 long spears. Heat a grill pan until smoking and char the spears for 2 minutes a side until marked. Mix 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp caster sugar and the zest of a lime. Squeeze the lime over the warm pineapple, sprinkle with the chilli mix, push a skewer into each spear and chill for 20 minutes before serving.
M: a long hot day on the block
Sticky barbecue chicken drumsticks off the grill with buttered corn on the cob and potato salad, eaten on the steps.
W: Big Worm's ice cream truck cones
Big Worm's ice cream truck rolling down the street
Vanilla ice cream cones dipped in chocolate that sets hard and rolled in crushed cornflakes and sprinkles, like the truck sells.

Craig's kitchen has the drink but no sugar
Homemade red fruit drink of strawberry, cherry and lemon, sweetened properly and poured over plenty of ice in big plastic cups.

Press together into 4 sandwiches and butter the outsides with 40g soft butter. Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the filling is warm. Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season well. Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, then top each with a folded slice of ham browned in the pan and half a cheese slice, cover for 1 minute to melt. Put in 12 slider buns with pickles.

m.note: a long hot day on the block
m.how: Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with salt, pepper and 2 tsp smoked paprika and roast at 200C for 30 minutes. Brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill or roast 15 minutes more, basting twice, until sticky. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, roll in 40g butter and serve with 500g potato salad.

w.n: Big Worm's ice cream truck cones
w.note: Big Worm's ice cream truck rolling down the street
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 3 tbsp coconut oil and let it cool to room temperature. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 8 cones, freeze them for 20 minutes, then dip each top in the chocolate and roll straight away in 40g crushed cornflakes mixed with 2 tbsp sprinkles. Freeze until serving.

d.n: Red drink, with sugar this time
d.note: Craig's kitchen has the drink but no sugar
d.how: Blend 250g strawberries with 150g caster sugar and the juice of 2 lemons, then strain into a big jug. Add 500ml cherry juice and 1L cold water and stir until the sugar is gone. Pour over plenty of ice in big plastic cups.
